ores.structure: Ochre streaks and dull dense nodules
Irregular green-brown folded bands in warm rock
Pale granular pockets across dark bedding
Heat-marked dark host with deeply recessed internal ember fracture
One narrow branching pale metallic seam, no crystal spikes

purposes.seed: Repeatable mineral paths and source shaping; no gameplay RNG.
purposes.size_blender_m: Fits measured fallback ore body with 6 cm horizontal, 10 cm height clearance; not the ordinary terrain ribbon.
purposes.lod_triangles: Maximum triangles per displayed stock/crack candidate; source masters retain finer geometry.
purposes.lod_distances_m: Isolated review changes detail at 8 and 20 m; not a world budget or streamer change.
purposes.scar_depth_m: Physical incision through the host, visible with light disabled; restricted to ember structure and native cracked candidates.
purposes.scar_half_width_m: Width of broken margins around the inset channel on the half-metre host.
purposes.pulse_period_s: Quiet heat shimmer cycle only while native heat is present; explicit pause-aware clock.
purposes.ores: Fixed material colour, host tint, roughness and metallic response distinguish mineral structure. Units mirror current definitions and are asserted, never used to change stock.
purposes.stone_surface: One shared seeded periodic grey stone albedo/roughness tile, 1024 square, triplanar scale 1.7 repeats per metre. Avoids UV atlas stretching across LODs; original source maps stay packed and unchanged.
